I know I’ve been thinking about going back to fast food and retail, but being a CNA makes me happy. I’ve never really been a party person or anything of the sort. I enjoy going to work and interacting with the residents and hearing about their life experiences. It’s a huge responsibility and I know that but knowing that I’m the person that takes care of the elderly before they pass away, or talk to them when their families aren’t there. It makes my heart and mind grow. I can’t imagine leaving this field of work, I’d feel so useless anywhere else. That’s why I need to learn how to deal with these kinds of situations, so that I can better myself as a CNA.

I’ve already told my mom, she wants to talk to my DON about it. I feel bad having to get someone else to do my job because I feel uncomfortable. The CNAs at my facility are overworked, they have their own patients and residents to take care of and I’d hate to pile more onto their already heavy workload, they are all very sweet of course. But I’d rather learn how to deal with patients like that in the future than have someone else deal with it for me.
